heading: Curiosity, set in motion
lead: For museums, planetariums, universities, libraries and public spaces. A life-sized orrery turns the solar system from a diagram into a place: visitors walk among the planets, watch them move and leave with questions they'll be asking for years.
pointsHeading: An education you can stand inside

points.title: Learn by being there
points.text: Scale, motion and distance become something felt rather than read. The planets really move, each at its own pace around the Sun.

points.title: A layer of knowledge with Aurora
points.text: Our augmented-reality add-on reveals orbits, names, celestial objects and stories about every world, right over the real thing.

points.title: A programme for every visit
points.text: With the Planetary Controller, educators can run motion scenes, recreate the sky on historic dates and light each planet in turn.

startingPoint.heading: A starting point
startingPoint.text: One of the configurations we'd suggest for a public collection. Use it as inspiration, or as the first sketch of your own.

closing.heading: Spark a lifetime of wonder.
closing.text: Tell us about your visitors and your space.
